selector_policy: Known schema paths and value types; no case ID, host, vendor value or verdict-based filtering. Unknown business fields retained.

rules.treatment: Backend bookkeeping; expose only a short material-unavailable, stale-analysis or omitted-input notice when applicable.
Full ledger retained; no bulk JSON. Material limitations and nonduplicated activity time/object/business values remain visible; meaningful label definitions retained.
Omit score computation and its metadata from I input, retain original storage.
Keep nonempty business signals; treat as detection background, not observed behavior.
Use the configured typed dictionary; unknown values keep their original representation.
Backend routing/source metadata; no test-value-specific filtering.
Drop index copies only when the same member/material has matching original observations and no additional business fields or normalization differences; other objects remain.
Preserve text verbatim; no manual correction or model-generated summary.
Keep original keys/values, including 0/false and meaningful empty lists; do not apply metadata rules recursively by key name.
